subject: Mid-quarter leadership: OKR priorities, scope shifts & infra dependency ask
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: partners@cloudmarket.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter leadership: OKR priorities, scope shifts & infra dependency ask

Team —

Quick mid-quarter note ahead of QBR prep. I ran the latest OKR roll-up this morning (attached) and flagged three things that need leadership alignment before I finalize the deck:

1) Status snapshot (top-level)
- Product: Feature parity milestone for streaming / tool-calls is at 58% (KR owner: Marissa).
- Platform: Latency KR (P95 < 150ms for hosted) is trending 12% behind plan due to inference batching throughput limits (Ben).
- GTM: Trials-to-paid rate improving; early signs of expansion in two mid-market accounts (Aditya / Sales).

2) Proposed re-scope / trade-offs
- Recommend we reduce the Product KR from “full streaming + tool-call coverage” to “streaming for high-priority models + tool-call MVP” for this quarter to preserve runway for platform work. This is a scope change, not a target change — we keep the same objective but adjust deliverables.

3) Immediate dependency ask for Platform (blocking latency KR)
- We need a short-term Dedicated capacity reservation (4x A100-equivalent GPU slots) for 3 weeks to run end-to-end batching experiments and KV-cache tuning. Outcome: validate kernel+batching config that should close the gap to P95 targets.
- Owner ask: Ben, can you surface capacity availability and cost estimate by EOD Wednesday? I attached a one-page capacity request template to speed procurement conversation.

4) Customer impact & communications
- Sarah Liao at Acme is sensitive to latency regressions; Aditya flagged potential renewal impact if we can’t provide the expected SLO. Including Sarah here so we’re aligned on timing and messaging.

Decision needed by Wednesday COB: Approve temporary capacity commit (yes/no) and accept the Product KR re-scope. If we get a yes, I’ll update the QBR deck and include a short canary plan.

Attachments: okr-progress-2026-08-09.pdf, capacity-request-template.xlsx, qbr-deck-v0.2.pptx

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Product & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter leadership: OKR priorities, scope shifts & infra dependency ask

Vivek —

Thanks for the concise roll-up. I agree we should prioritize stabilizing P95 for hosted customers; the renewal risk is real. A couple quick points: 
- I support the Product re-scope for this quarter as long as we document the rollback/complete scope plan for Q3.
- Ben: can you also confirm whether we can run the experiments against a staging fleet that mirrors production? That will reduce both cost and risk if we can reproduce production traffic patterns.

I can greenlight a temporary commit up to 3 weeks if we get: (a) cost estimate, (b) a short test plan, and (c) a clear owner for the canary.

Laura Bennett
Head of Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

Vivek / Laura / Ben —

Quick operational note from Product: if we re-scope streaming to high-priority models + tool-call MVP, the engineering team can reallocate ~2.5 FTEs to help with the latency experiments starting next week. That reduces the time-to-result for the infra experiments but not the capacity need — we still require isolated GPU slots to replicate batching behavior at scale.

Ben — I put a draft capacity timeline in the capacity-request-template.xlsx (attached). If we can get provisional capacity committed by Friday, we can run a 10-day experiment window and produce a go/no-go recommendation prior to the QBR.

Sarah — I appreciate you joining the thread. We’ll include a short note in the QBR on the temporary trade-off and proposed corrective plan. Expect a targeted update by Thursday.

—Marissa

Vivek / all —

I pulled initial numbers with Infra and Finance. Quick answers: 
- Capacity availability: We can provision 4x A100-equivalent slots in us-west for a 3-week window starting as early as Aug 17, pending quick sign-off.
- Cost: ~USD 23k for reserved short-term capacity (includes burst margin). Final invoice depends on exact instance families — I’ll confirm by Wednesday.
- Staging replication: We can run the experiments in a staging fleet gated behind the canary pipeline; traffic replay will be limited to a 10% sampling of production to control blast radius.

Action items I’ll own and update:
- Ben: finalize order & cost estimate by Wed COB (INF-4821)
- Marissa: handoff 2.5 FTE and test cases by Thu
- Vivek: update QBR deck and customer note; I’ll sync with Finance after we confirm cost.

If leadership approves, I’ll open the procurement ticket and loop in CloudMarket partner for marketplace provisioning.

Ben Carter
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
